title: Crab and new potato salad
summary: Crab and new potato salad is a mediterranean dinner built around white crab meat and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook white crab meat for Crab and new potato salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm little gem lettuce alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss new potatoes with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Crab and new potato salad straight away. Taste Crab and new potato salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
